blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Classifying a whole-slide image requires encoding thousands of high-resolution tiles with a pathology foundation model, which accounts for most of the inference cost. Existing efficient methods reduce this cost by selecting fewer tiles, but typically train a new model around their selection strategy. A largely unexplored alternative is to keep an existing full-bag model frozen and run it on selected tiles at the same encoder cost. We introduce this comparison, alongside random tile sampling at matched cost. To select tiles, we fit a lightweight selector with 3.3K parameters to the attention of a frozen model, without additional slide labels. The selector ranks regions from a slide thumbnail, encodes the top K regions at 5x magnification, and selects b for processing at 20x. We evaluate seven frozen MIL aggregators on six tasks and compare them with nine efficient methods trained on the same features and splits. At a budget of (K,b)=(1000,10), encoding costs about 6.6% of the full bag and is 10-14x faster, excluding tiling. The AUROC drop is no more than 0.005 in 33 of 36 aggregator-task pairs. At (500,10), the cost falls to about 4% and inference is 13-22x faster, but AUROC drops by up to 0.035 on CAMELYON17, where small metastases are easily missed. Selection improves over random sampling by about 0.10 AUROC on tasks with focal lesions, while random sampling performs well on diffuse tasks. In our comparisons, the frozen model at (500,10) is ahead of nine efficient methods in 55 of 60 paired comparisons. Giving an existing WSI model fewer tiles is thus a baseline that a new efficient model should be compared with at matched encoder cost.
blocks.zh: 将一整个滑坡图像分类需要用病理基础模型编码上千个高分辨率的瓦片,这占了推论成本的大部分. 现有的高效方法通过选择更少的瓷砖来降低这一成本,但通常围绕其选择策略来训练出一个新的模型. 一个基本上未探索的替代品是将现有的全袋模型冷冻并用同样的编码器成本在选定的瓷砖上运行. 我们采用这种比较,同时以相应的成本随机抽取瓷砖。 要选择瓷砖,我们把一个有3.3K参数的轻量级选择器放入被冷冻的模型的注意下,而不增加幻灯片标签. 选择者从幻灯片缩略图中排列区域,以5x放大来编码上K区域,以20x来选择b进行处理. 我们评价了七个被冻结的MIL集合器的六个任务,并将它们同九个经过同样特征和分块训练的有效方法进行比较。 在(K,b)=(1000,10)的预算中,编码费用约为满袋的6.6%,而且速度快于10-14x,不包括地砖. AUROC的降幅在36个聚合任务对中的33个不超过0.005. 在(500,10)时,成本下降到了约4%,推论速度快于13-22x,但AUROC在CAMELYON17上下降了0.035,在这里很容易错过了小元站. 选择性比随机抽样改进了约0.10 AUROC在有焦病的任务上,随机抽样在分散任务上表现良好。 在我们的比较中,冻结在(500,10)的模型在60对比较的55个中领先于9个高效方法. 因此,减少现有的西安系统模型的瓦片,是按相应的编码器成本对新的有效模型进行比较的基线。

blocks.en: A whole-slide image (WSI) is commonly classified by encoding every tile at a fine magnification with a pathology foundation model and aggregating the resulting features using multiple instance learning (MIL) [ 11 , 15 , 5 , 31 , 28 ] . On our six design tasks a slide has on average 12.2 12.2 to 15.4 15.4 thousand tiles at 20 × 20\times magnification, and encoding them costs 4.1 4.1 to 5.2 5.2 PFLOPs and a median of 35 35 to 74 74 seconds per slide (Supplementary Table S1 and S2). The encoding accounts for more than 99.9 % 99.9\% of the computation, so the way to save is to encode fewer tiles.
blocks.zh: 全滑成像(WSI)通常通过用病理基础模型将每个瓦片编码在精细的放大上并使用多实例学习(MIL)[11,15,5,31,28]来汇总所产生的特征来分类. 在我们的六项设计任务中,一个幻灯片平均有12.2至15.4万瓦,放大20×20正时,并编码它们的费用为4.1至5.2PFLOP和35至7474秒的中位数(补充表S1和S2)。 编码占计算量的99.9%以上,因此保存的方法是将平板编码更少.

blocks.en: Efficient MIL methods do this by training a new aggregator around their own tile selection for one budget [ 25 , 27 , 9 , 23 , 6 , 24 , 2 ] . The saving is uneven, because these methods encode every coarse region or every tile before they choose. In our reruns four of the nine methods (HDMIL, IPS, HAG-MIL and DiagMIL) still cost 63 63 to 106 % 106\% of the full bag (Table 2 ). One comparison is also missing: a laboratory usually already has a full-bag model, trained and checked on its own slides. The question it faces is whether a new efficient model is better than that model, left unchanged and given fewer tiles at the same encoder cost. Two baselines answer it, namely the existing model on tiles picked by a cheap ranking and the existing model on random tiles of the same cost. Without them, a reported saving cannot be separated from what any cheap subset of tiles would give.
blocks.zh: 高效率的MIL方法通过培训新的集合器来做到这一点,围绕它们自己挑选的瓷砖进行一项预算[25、27、9、23、6、24、2]。 节约是不均衡的,因为这些方法在选择之前将每个粗细的区域或每个瓦片编码. 在我们重新运行的九种方法中,有四种方法(HDMIL、IPS、HAG-MIL和DiagMIL)仍然花费了全袋的63至106%(表2)。 一个比较也缺失了:实验室通常已经拥有了全袋模型,经过了训练,并用自己的幻灯片检查. 它面临的问题是,一个新的高效模型是否比该模型更好,没有变化,以同样的编码器成本给予的瓦片是否更少. 有两个基线可以回答这个问题,即由廉价排名选择的瓦片上的现有模型和同样成本的随机瓦片上的现有模型. 没有它们,所报道的节省就不能与任何廉价的分块瓷砖所能提供的东西相分离。

blocks.en: We study how few tiles an existing model needs. A frozen attention model already marks the regions it relies on, and we find that a linear scorer can predict this attention before the tiles are encoded. Our selector has two such scorers ( 3,328 3{,}328 weights). The first ranks the regions of a slide from its thumbnail, and the top K K regions are encoded at 5 × 5\times . The second ranks those regions from their 5 × 5\times features, and the top b b are encoded at 20 × 20\times . The existing model sees only these 20 × 20\times tiles, with its weights unchanged (Fig. 1 , Fig. 2 ). Both scorers are fitted once to the attention of a frozen gated ABMIL on the training slides, with no new labels, and the same fit serves every budget ( K , b ) (K,b) and every aggregator. Fitting takes 4 to 26 minutes per split, compared with 30 minutes to 28 hours for efficient baselines trained for a single budget (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们研究现有模型需要多少瓷砖。 一个被冷冻的注意力模型已经标记了它所依赖的区域,我们发现线性计分器可以在瓷砖被编码之前预测这种注意力. 我们的选手有两个这样的分数(3,328 3{,}328个重). 第一位将幻灯片区域从缩略图中排出, K 最高区域编码为 5× 5\times 。 排名第二的这些区域从它们的5×5\times特性中排出,而最高的b被编码为20×20\times. 现有的模型只看到这20×20\times牌,其重量不变(图1,图2). 两个计分员在训练幻灯片上都装有被冷冻的门牌ABMIL,没有新的标签,同样的尺寸用于每个预算(K、b)(K、b)。 每分拨进行交接需要4至26分钟,而为单一预算培训的有效基线需要30至28小时(表1)。

blocks.en: We evaluate seven frozen MIL aggregators on six design tasks with two encoders, and on three held-out tasks fixed in advance. We compare each reading with its full-bag counterpart, random tile selection at the same encoder cost, the model’s own attention, and nine efficient methods trained on identical features and splits. We report three findings.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了7个被冻结的MIL聚合器,其中6个是设计任务,两个是编码器,另外3个是预先确定的被搁置的任务。 我们比较一下每个读取与全包的对应,随机的瓷砖选择,同样的编码器成本,模型本身的注意力,以及9种有效的方法,训练相同的特性和分块. 我们报告三项调查结果。

blocks.en: First, existing models maintain most of their performance at a small fraction of encoder cost (Table 2 ). At ( K , b ) = ( 1000 , 10 ) (K,b)=(1000,10) , about 6.6 % 6.6\% of the full-bag encoder cost and 10 × 10\times to 14 × 14\times faster with tiling excluded, six frozen aggregators remain within 0.005 0.005 AUROC of their full-bag performance in 33 of 36 comparisons. The budget was chosen on the design results of gated ABMIL alone and the other five aggregators, read only after it was fixed, are within 0.005 0.005 in 27 of 30 pairs (Supplementary section I).
blocks.zh: 首先,现有模型维持其大部分性能,成本为编码器成本的一小部分(表2. 在(K, b) = (1000, 10) (K, b) = (1000, 10) 时, 约6.6%的全袋编码器成本和10×10x14x14x14x14的快活,在36个比较中,有33个的全袋性能的6个冷冻聚合器保持在0.0050.005以内。 预算是仅根据有门的ABMIL的设计结果选定的,其他5个总合器在固定后才读取,在30对总合器的27个中不超过0.005 0.005(补充第一节)。

blocks.en: Second, going below the coarse level costs the smallest lesions. At ( 500 , 10 ) (500,10) , about 4 % 4\% of the cost and 13 × 13\times to 22 × 22\times faster, the count falls to 22 of 36. On CAMELYON17 the frozen models lose up to 0.035 0.035 AUROC, mostly on slides whose only lesions are isolated tumour cells, and, at a validation threshold set for 98 % 98\% sensitivity, 0.02 0.02 to 0.19 0.19 of specificity (Supplementary Table S27). A budget chosen on a model’s own validation slides holds on average out of sample, but when the selector was moved between lymph-node cohorts it chose a budget that lost 0.017 0.017 AUROC on CAMELYON16.
blocks.zh: 第二,如果低于粗糙的水平,则损失最小。 在(500, 10) (500, 10), 成本的4%左右, 13 × 13 乘以 22 × 22 乘以 更快, 倒计时为 36 分中的 22 分. 在CAMELYON17上,被冻结的型号损失了0.035 0.035 AUROC,大多是在只有损伤为孤立肿瘤细胞的滑行上,在98%的98-%敏感度设定的验证阈值上,特异性为0.02 0.02至0.19 (补充表S27)。 在模型本身的验证幻灯片上所选择的预算平均不包含样本,但当选择器在淋巴-节点组群之间移动时,它选择了一个在CAMELYON16上损失了0.017 0.017 AUROC的预算。

blocks.en: Third, efficient methods rarely outperform the model they would replace (Table 2 ). In our reruns, the frozen gated ABMIL at about 4 % 4\% is ahead of ten settings of nine efficient methods in 55 of 60 paired comparisons. Its own full bag is ahead in 59, so the selection keeps the lead of the full-bag model and does not create it. Part of the gap may be tuning, which this comparison does not separate.
blocks.zh: 第三,有效的方法很少比它们所取代的模式效法(表2)。 在我们的重播中,被冻结的ABMIL 大约4% 4 % 领先于 10 个设置的 9 个有效方法 在 55 个60 对比。 它自己的"满包"在59年就领先了,因此选取保留了"满包"模型的领先地位,并没有创造出. 部分差距可能是调和的,这种比较并不分开.

blocks.en: We suggest that an efficient WSI method be compared with the existing full-bag model on selected and on random tiles at the same encoder cost. Code, splits, and the selector will be released upon acceptance.
blocks.zh: 我们建议以同样的编码器成本,在选定的和随机的瓦片上,将有效的WSI方法同现有的全包模型进行比较。 代码,分出,选定者在接受后会被释放.

blocks.en:
Coarse-to-fine reading. ZoomMIL zooms with a differentiable top- k k [ 25 ] , HAG-MIL builds an attention hierarchy [ 27 ] , GFR-MIL by glance, focus and reflect steps [ 21 ] , DiagMIL by an uncertainty gate between a coarse and a fine stage [ 12 ] and PathCTM by reasoning across scales with a stopping rule [ 9 ] , and agents choose regions sequentially [ 30 , 10 ] . WISE-FUSE scores every coarse patch against class descriptions with a pathology vision-language model and encodes the fine tiles of the best regions [ 23 ] , and the multiscale form of DSMIL pairs each coarse feature with the features of every fine tile inside it [ 13 ] .
Despite their different selection strategies, existing coarse-to-fine WSI methods share three limitations. First, they encode every coarse region before deciding which regions to process at fine resolution. This creates a minimum encoder cost determined by the coarse magnification, equal to ( s c / s f ) 2 (s_{\mathrm{c}}/s_{\mathrm{f}})^{2} of the full-bag cost. With a 20 × 20\times fine level, this corresponds to 6.25 % 6.25\% at 5 × 5\times and 1.6 % 1.6\% at 2.5 × 2.5\times . WISE-FUSE has a similar cost floor, with an additional vision-language encoder, while multiscale DSMIL encodes all tiles at both magnifications. Second, their budgets are either fixed during training or determined by the model’s own stopping rule. Changing the accuracy-cost trade-off may therefore require another model or additional training. Third, each method trains its own aggregator around its selection strategy, so it cannot be directly added to an existing full-bag model. Our method addresses these limitations by ranking regions from a thumbnail before encoding any tiles. This allows us to use different budgets without encoding every coarse region or changing the weights of an existing MIL model.
blocks.zh:
粗取细读. ZomMIL 以不同的上-k k [25] 放大,HAG-MIL 建立注意等级 [27],GFR-MIL 逐一浏览,聚焦并反映步骤 [21], DiagMIL 在粗糙阶段与精细阶段[12]和PathCTM之间设置一个不确定的门,通过有停止规则的跨尺度推理[9],代理人按顺序选择区域[30,10]。 WISE-FUSE将每个粗细的补丁与类描述进行比对,采用病理视觉语言模型,并编码出最佳区域的细瓦片 [23],以及多尺度的DSMIL配对形式,每个粗细的特征及其内每个细瓦片的特征 [13].
尽管其选择策略不同,但现有的粗糙至精细的WSI方法有三种局限性. 首先,它们将每个粗细区域编码,然后决定哪个区域可以妥善处理。 这创造了由粗放大决定的最小编码器成本,等于( s c / s f) 2 ( s_{\mathrm{ c}}/ s_{\mathrm{ f}}) 满袋的钱 在20×20分的精细水平下,这相当于5×5分的6.25% 6.25分,2.5×2.5分的1.6分。 WISE-FUSE有相类似的成本下限,增加了一个视觉语言编码器,而多尺度的DSMIL在两个放大时都编码了所有的瓦片. 第二,他们的预算不是在培训期间确定,就是由模式本身的停止规则确定。 因此,改变准确性成本权衡可能需要另一种模式或额外的培训。 第三,每种方法都会围绕其选择策略来训练自己的聚合器,因此不能直接添加到现有的全包模型中. 我们的方法是用缩略图对区域进行排序,然后对任何瓷砖进行编码。 这使得我们可以使用不同的预算,而不对每一个粗细的区域进行编码,也不改变现有MIL模型的权重.

blocks.en: Screening tiles before encoding. HDMIL screens tiles with a small network distilled from a full-bag teacher [ 6 ] , the prior work closest to fitting our selector to a frozen model, ADMIL scores the pixels of every tile with a small network and trains an aggregator per budget [ 24 ] , and IPS selects patches iteratively over all of them [ 2 ] . Limitation: they read and score every fine tile, and their budget is again fixed when they are trained. ADMIL, the cheapest network on every tile, reaches lower FLOPs than our default ( 0.2 0.2 to 2.4 % 2.4\% ), but with its scorer on 20 × 20\times tiles, as we run it, its measured time is bound by reading and decoding every tile ( 3.6 3.6 to 13.5 × 13.5\times faster than the full bag, tiling excluded, against 13 13 to 22 × 22\times for ours). A distilled encoder [ 8 ] makes each evaluation cheaper but meets the same bound. Looking at every tile can find lesions a coarse ranking misses. Our method first ranks regions using a thumbnail and then selects tiles at the coarse level. The two scorers are fitted once and can be used with an existing frozen MIL aggregator without retraining it. We also evaluate ADMIL in settings where it performs better than our method and where it does not (Sec. 5 ).

ADMIL是每块瓷砖上最便宜的网络,比我们的默认值(0. 0.2%至2.4% 2. 4% 2. 4%)达到更低的FLOP,但是它的得分器在20x20分的瓷砖上,当我们运行时,它所测量的时间是通过读取并解码每块瓷砖(3.6至13.5×13.5分快于全袋,除去地砖外,13-13-22分22分). 蒸馏编码器[8]使每次评价都更便宜,但符合相同的约束. 看看每块瓷砖 都能找到粗糙的损伤 我们的方法首先使用缩略图对区域进行排序,然后在粗体层次选择瓷砖. 两个计分器都装了一次,可以使用现有的被冻结的MIL聚合器而无需再培训. 我们还在ADMIL比我们的方法做得更好和不起作用的环境下评价ADMIL(第5节)。

blocks.en: 3 Protocol and instrument
blocks.zh: 3 议定书和文书

blocks.en:
Comparing at the same cost. An efficient WSI method reads a slide at some encoder cost and replaces a full-bag model g g that a laboratory already has. We compare these approaches with three readings of the same test slides. First, we measure the performance of g g when it processes the full bag of fine tiles. Second, we run the same mode g g , with its weight unchanged on fine tiles selected by an efficient ranking method at the same encoder cost. This tells us whether training a separate efficient model provides an advantage. Third, we run g g on random fine tiles of the same encoder cost. This allows us to measure the benefit of selecting tiles intelligently rather than randomly. Cost counts encoder evaluations and every other network a method runs, per slide (Sec. 4 ). We consider the mean AUROC to be maintained if it is no more than 0.005 below the full-bag result. For each individual aggregator and task, we use a non-inferiority margin of 0.010, which was fixed in advance. The second comparison requires a ranking method that is inexpensive and does not change the existing model g g . Our selector is described below.
We also test the frozen model’s own attention and the tile selections made by four existing efficient methods when they are used with g g at matched costs (Supplementary section G).

Setting and cost We consider a two-level reading process. The first level provides a coarse view, while the second provides a finer view that is s s times higher in resolution.
Each slide is divided into N N coarse regions with tissue. In our experiments the coarse level is 5 × 5\times ( 256 256 pixels, about 0.5 0.5 mm), the fine level 20 × 20\times ( 256 256 pixels, about 128 ​ μ 128\,\mu m). Therefore, the fine level is four times higher in resolution, giving s = 4 s=4 and m = 16 m=16 , and the encoder is Virchow2 [ 31 ] , with UNI2-h [ 5 , 16 ] as the second encoder.
The full bag encodes every fine patch. Under a budget defined by ( K , b ) (K,b) , the selector first keeps K K regions and then chooses b b of those regions for high-resolution processing. Choosing where to look Thumbnail gate. The slide thumbnail is encoded once at 1022 1022 pixels on the long side by DINOv2 ViT-B/14 [ 20 ] (about 2 2 TFLOPs, the cost of six Virchow2 evaluations), and each region takes the token containing its centre. A linear attention scorer ψ th \psi_{\mathrm{th}} ranks all regions and the gate keeps the top K K , 𝒢 K \mathcal{G}_{K} . The thumbnail provides a low-resolution overview of the slide, but it cannot reliably locate individual lesions. Its purpose is to keep potentially informative tissue regions, not to identify lesions directly. Coarse scorer and zoom set. After applying the thumbnail gate, we encode the retained regions at the coarse level using Enc ⁡ ( u r ) \mathrm{Enc}(u_{r}) .
A second scorer ψ c \psi_{\mathrm{c}} ranks these regions and the b b zoomable regions of 𝒢 K \mathcal{G}_{K} with the highest score are zoomed, 𝒢 K \displaystyle\mathcal{G}_{K} = top K ⁡ { ψ th ​ ( t r ) } , \displaystyle=\operatorname{top}_{K}\{\psi_{\mathrm{th}}(t_{r})\}, (2) 𝒵 K , b \displaystyle\mathcal{Z}_{K,b} = top b { ψ c ( Enc ( u r ) ) : r ∈ 𝒢 K , 𝒞 ( r ) ≠ ∅ } , \displaystyle=\operatorname{top}_{b}\{\psi_{\mathrm{c}}(\mathrm{Enc}(u_{r})):r\in\mathcal{G}_{K},\ \mathcal{C}(r)\neq\emptyset\}, with t r t_{r} the region’s thumbnail token.
The two scorers work at different levels of detail. The thumbnail is inexpensive but too coarse to reliably identify individual lesions. It is used to retain regions that may contain useful information. The coarse scorer then uses pathology features to decide which of these regions should be tested at high resolution. In this way, the thumbnail gate prioritizes coverage, while the coarse scorer makes a more detailed selection. Neither scorer evaluates regions outside the thumbnail gate.

blocks.en: Two ways to set the budget. We evaluate two strategies for choosing the budget. The fast budget reads every slide at D = ( 500 , 10 ) D=(500,10) , fixed once for all tasks during design and before the held-out tasks were trained. It is not tuned. A second named point, ( 1000 , 10 ) (1000,10) , doubles the gate. We selected this second budget based on the development results of gated ABMIL and then used it for the other aggregators and held-out settings (Supplementary section I). The performance-first rule chooses each model’s budget from its own training and validation slides, walking down a ladder of budgets from the full bag while a bootstrap bound on the AUROC loss stays within a margin. This approach follows the general idea of fixed-sequence testing [ 17 , 1 ] but without its error-rate guarantee (Supplementary section H). We fixed the selection rule before reporting its results.

blocks.en: A selector with 3,328 3{,}328 weights, fitted to a frozen model’s attention with no new labels, lets an existing MIL model read about 6.6 % 6.6\% of its encoder cost at ( 1000 , 10 ) (1000,10) and stay within 0.005 0.005 AUROC of its full bag in 33 of 36 aggregator-task pairs, without retraining. At the fast budget D D , about 4 % 4\% , the count is 22 of 36 and CAMELYON17 loses up to 0.035 0.035 , which the performance-first rule recovers only at 64 64 to 94 % 94\% of the cost. At D D the model is still ahead of nine efficient methods in 55 of 60 paired comparisons, so we suggest that an efficient WSI method report the existing model on selected and on random tiles at matched encoder cost. Fitting takes 4 to 26 minutes per split, so a laboratory can check its own model before training a new one.

All timings use one NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation GPU (48 GB, driver 575.57.08) with no other process on it, two Intel Xeon Gold 5318Y CPUs (24 cores each) with 1 TB of memory, and slides stored on local NVMe SSDs. The software is Python 3.13.9, PyTorch 2.6.0 with CUDA 12.4, timm 1.0.29 and openslide-python 1.4.6 on OpenSlide 4.0.1. Virchow2 runs in half precision on batches of 64 tiles without torch.compile , and the DINOv2 thumbnail encoder runs in single precision. Sixteen reader processes on one CPU socket decode the tiles. FLOPs are counted with PyTorch’s FlopCounterMode on one 224 × 224 224\times 224 tile, with each multiply-add counted as two operations, which gives 340 GFLOPs per Virchow2 evaluation.
Peak GPU memory allocated during a read, CUDA context excluded, is 2,183 2{,}183 MiB on each of the six tasks for the full bag, D D and ( 1000 , 10 ) (1000,10) alike, 1,566 1{,}566 MiB of it the encoder weights, because the peak is set by one batch of 64 tiles and not by the number of tiles read.

blocks.en: Registered before any of these reads, this test runs the performance-first rule of Sec. H unchanged, from the source of the frozen rule, on models and slides that took no part in building it. On the held-out tasks it reads the 45 frozen models of Table S31 (three tasks, three aggregators, 5 runs each), re-read at the 32 budgets with training and validation predictions saved, and each budget is chosen on that model’s own training and validation slides. For the unseen centre it reads the 15 CAMELYON17 models trained with one centre left out, each budget chosen on that split’s training and validation slides and scored on the left-out centre, and the 15 in-distribution controls that see every centre in training. On SLN-Breast it reads the 25 frozen CAMELYON17 gated ABMIL models, each at the budget already chosen for it on CAMELYON17, so SLN-Breast is not used to choose. The registered criterion is that of the design tasks, the rule within 0.005 0.005 of the full bag, mean over the runs of a setting. The two transfers between CAMELYON16 and CAMELYON17 are not part of this registration (Table S22 ).

blocks.en: The criterion is met in all 12 settings, the 11 out of sample and the control on CAMELYON17 centres seen in training. The rule minus the full bag is − 0.003 -0.003 to + 0.007 +0.007 , and 97 of 100 runs are within 0.005 0.005 of their own full bag, 83 of 85 out of sample. On the PANDA tasks the rule never keeps the full bag and reads 37 37 to 58 % 58\% of the encoder evaluations. Its loss there is at most 0.003 0.003 , but on PANDA ISUP the interval excludes zero for all three aggregators, and on PANDA cancer for gated ABMIL. These slides are biopsies with few regions, where even ( 100 , 10 ) (100,10) reads 37 % 37\% (gated ABMIL on PANDA ISUP, which chose it in every run). On KIRC grade the rule keeps the full bag in 9 of 15 runs, at 60 60 to 87 % 87\% . On the CAMELYON17 centres it keeps the full bag in 10 and 12 of 15 runs, as it does on CAMELYON17 itself, and on SLN-Breast the CAMELYON17 choices cost 87 % 87\% and are less than 0.001 0.001 below the full bag in every run. The 3 runs outside 0.005 0.005 are TransMIL on KIRC grade ( − 0.008 -0.008 ), the centre left out ( − 0.008 -0.008 ) and the centre seen in training ( − 0.021 -0.021 ). The criterion holds for the mean over a setting’s runs, not for every run. Keeping the full bag would also meet it, so where the rule mostly keeps the full bag the test shows that it does not lose, not that it saves.
